`npm test` passes with all 11 tests.

Summary: `addWorkingDays` in `src/workdays.ts` now computes England and Wales bank holidays per year (New Year's Day, Good Friday, Easter Monday via the Anonymous Gregorian Easter algorithm, first/last Monday of May, last Monday of August, Christmas Day, Boxing Day), with the substitute-holiday rule applied in order (New Year → Christmas → Boxing Day) so a substitute never collides with an already-placed holiday. Added 8 new tests in `src/workdays.test.ts` covering each holiday type, weekend substitution, and the Christmas/Boxing Day collision case (2022).
